description: AI City 2021 Track 4 train videos that share a camera view. Built from edge-map similarity of frames at 5 s and 300 s (threshold 0.6), checked by eye on contact sheets; video 12 added to the 35/38/40/82 group by eye. Video 2 had no extracted frame and stays alone. Videos not listed are their own group.
method: max Pearson correlation of blurred Sobel edge maps (96x54) over frame pairs; union-find at >= 0.6
